blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
blocks.zh: 长视野因素在持续的任务状态下累积了进展,但反复说明了如何取得这种进展的流程互动历史。 这自然提出了一个问题:长距离背景能否围绕可重复使用的进展而不是产生这种进展的历史来安排? 在本文中,我们引入了面向对象的上下文运行时间(World On),它围绕可重复使用的任务对象组织续作. 与其将压缩历史或重建的进展叙述作为延续的主要依据,WorldOn从延续载体、互补执行背景和最近互动的活后起伏的角度构建了上下文。 一项核心挑战是,在其周围历史退役后,这一可重复使用的基础仍然有效:如何携带 在更新的基础上,而不重建每一行的完整代表? 携带 保持承运人的记录,根据约束性证据和适用的环境检查修订受影响的记录,同时结转未受影响的记录并联合更新执行背景。 在OSWorld 2.0和浏览器Comp-Plus上的实验显示,分别提高了5.8%和7.0%,同时将总的象征性使用量减少了51.9%和22.9%。 项目网页:https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in two places: persistent task state, which embodies what has been achieved, and interaction history, which records how it was achieved ( Yi et al., 2026 ) .
As shown in Figure 1 , once images have been inserted into a presentation or measurements have been entered into a report, the resulting task state already captures that progress for later steps to inspect and modify ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
As execution continues, this redundancy grows: agents repeatedly process accounts of how results already available in the task state were produced.
Existing methods manage growing histories by summarizing, retrieving, or pruning past interactions ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Packer et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , or by translating them into explicit progress records and structured task states ( Wu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
These approaches reduce context growth, but when they substitute for reusable task results, they make continuation depend on a redundant, selective account that can drift from the state the agent directly inspects and modifies.
blocks.zh:
长视剂在两地积累了进步:持续的任务状态,体现了已经取得的成就;互动历史,记录了它是如何实现的(Yi等,2026年).
如图1所示,一旦图像被插入演示文稿或测量结果被输入报告,由此产生的任务状态就已经记录了以后检查和修改步骤的进展(杨等,2024;谢等,2024;张等,2026)。
随着执行的继续,这种冗余性会增加:代理商会反复处理关于任务状态中已经存在的结果是如何产生的.
现有方法通过总结、检索或回顾过去的相互作用来管理不断增长的历史 (Wu等,2026b;Packer等,2024;Xiao等,2026;Chen等,2026b;Kang等,2025;徐等,2025),或将其转化为明确的进度记录和结构化的任务状态(Wu等,2026a; 陈等,2026a; 王等, 2024 (中文(简体) ).
这些方法会降低上下文的增长,但当它们取代可重复使用的任务结果时,它们会使得延续依赖于一个多余的,选择性的账户,该账户可以从状态中漂移,代理直接检查并修改.

blocks.en: We challenge this reliance on reconstructed accounts of progress with an object-oriented view of long-horizon context, in which reusable task objects form the basis for continuation. These objects include work products, source-grounded findings, and application states that remain usable under explicit conditions. The agent can recover relevant information through direct inspection and use of these objects, while context supplies the complementary information needed to continue. To realize this view, we introduce CarryOn, a context runtime that organizes the agent’s context into three complementary components: continuation carriers , which bind reusable content or object references to their conditions of use; execution context , which preserves active goals, applicable constraints, and unresolved issues not captured by the carriers; and live tail , which retains interactions since the most recent successful fold.
blocks.zh: 我们对这种依赖以面向对象的视角看待长视距的重构进展的叙述提出质疑,在长视距背景下,可重复使用的任务对象构成延续的基础。 这些物品包括工作产品、基于源的发现和在明确条件下仍然可以使用的应用状态。 物剂可以通过直接检查和使用这些物体来取回相关信息,而上下文则提供了继续所需的补充信息. 为了实现这一看法,我们引入了AllOn(上下文运行时间),将代理商的上下文组织为三个互补部分:续载机,它将可重复使用的内容或对其使用条件的引用对象捆绑起来;执行上下文,它保留了主动目标、适用的限制和承运人没有抓住的未决问题;活尾,它保留了自最近成功折叠以来的互动。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Context folding with reusable task objects in long-horizon OSWorld2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Top: In a slide-editing task, the working presentation and exported images carry completed editing progress, while remaining constraints and save verification stay explicit, reducing active context from 42.4K to 14.4K tokens (66.0%). Bottom: In a lab-report task, the working document carries completed edits, while unresolved calculations remain explicit, reducing active context from 58.4K to 23.5K tokens (59.7%).

blocks.en:
A central challenge in building object-oriented long-horizon context is retiring interaction history once progress becomes reusable without losing the information required for continuation, which poses three challenges: 1) how to identify reusable progress beyond its surrounding history: Some results still depend on prior interactions for interpretation or use. CarryOn captures these dependencies as conditions of use explicit in continuation carriers. 2) how to maintain reusable progress as the task evolves: Retaining a record does not by itself establish that its content remains supported or its referenced state remains available. CarryOn binds updates to supporting sources and applicable environment checks; across folds, affected records are revised while unaffected records are carried forward.
Finally, what must remain explicit when the corresponding history is retired: Task objects do not need to capture the goals, constraints, and unresolved issues that guide subsequent execution. CarryOn jointly updates continuation carriers and execution context to preserve this complementary information, while keeping recent interactions in a live tail.
Once validated, these updates are committed through a fold , replacing the covered interaction history with the resulting object-oriented context view.
In this way, CarryOn progressively reorganizes the long-horizon context around reusable task objects while preserving the information required for the agent to continue.
blocks.zh:
在构建面向对象的长视距背景下,一个中心挑战是,一旦进展可以重复使用,同时又不失去持续所需的信息,互动历史就不再存在。 1) 如何确定在其周围历史之外可重复使用的进展: 一些结果仍然取决于事先的相互作用,以便解释或使用。 携带 将这些依赖性作为继续承运人的明确使用条件。 (2) 随着任务的发展,如何保持可重复使用的进展: 保留记录本身并不证实其内容仍然得到支持,或其参考状态仍然可用。 携带 在将更新与辅助来源和适用环境检查捆绑在一起时;在各种折叠中,修改受影响的记录,同时将未受影响的记录结转。
最后,当相应历史退休时,必须明确: 任务对象不需要捕捉指导后继执行的目标,制约和未决问题. 携带 关于联合更新续航母和执行上下文,以保存这一补充信息,同时将最近的互动保持在活尾.
一旦验证,这些更新通过折叠执行,将覆盖的交互历史取而代之的面向对象上下文视图.
这样,CARLOON将围绕可重复使用的任务对象逐渐重组长视距上下文,同时保留代理机继续运行所需的信息.

blocks.en: In our experiments, object-oriented context management improves task performance while substantially reducing context cost. Our method, CarryOn, lifts Claude Opus 4.7 from 43.9% to 49.7% (+5.8%) on OSWorld 2.0 for long-horizon computer use and from 49% to 56% (+7%) on BrowseComp-Plus for long-horizon browsing. At the same time, it reduces total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, and total cost by 35.9% and 7.1%, on the two benchmarks, respectively. Compressing history alone is insufficient for continued execution: organizing context around reusable progress improves over generic compression, while the full CarryOn runtime further improves over the same principles implemented through repeated summarization. Continuation carriers and execution context play complementary roles, and reusable progress is typically maintained across folds rather than repeatedly reconstructed.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,面向对象的上下文管理可以提高任务性能,同时可以大幅度降低上下文的成本. 我们的方法"CarryOn"将Claude Opus 4.7从OSWorld 2.0上的43.9%提升到49.7%(+5.8%)用于长视距计算机使用,将Claude Opus 4.7从49%提升到56%(+7%)用于长视距浏览。 同时,根据两个基准,它分别减少了51.9%和22.9%的象征性使用,总费用减少了35.9%和7.1%。 仅仅压缩历史不足以持续执行:围绕可重复使用的进展组织上下文比一般压缩要好,而全载运行时间则比通过重复归纳执行的相同原则有进一步改善. 持续载体和执行环境发挥互补作用,可重复使用的进展通常在折叠之间保持,而不是反复重建。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing methods reduce long-horizon context by compressing, pruning, summarizing, or selectively retrieving prior interactions ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . Compression and pruning range from prompt-level compression ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) to removal of redundant or outdated interactions ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Summarization methods periodically replace accumulated interactions with compact reasoning states or learned summaries ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) , while branch-based execution can return only compact subtask results ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . External-history methods instead keep the active context bounded while preserving access to earlier interactions outside the prompt ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and some systems validate compressed representations against subsequent execution to reduce information loss ( Chen et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过压缩、压缩、归纳、总结或有选择地检索先前的相互作用来减少长视距上下文 (Wei等,2026). 压缩和挤压范围从即时级压缩(Jiang等,2023;Jiang等,2024)到去除多余或过时的相互作用(Xiao等,2026). 总结方法定期用紧凑推理状态或所学摘要来取代累积的相互作用(Wu等,2026b;Kang等,2026;Ye等,2025;Hu等,2025),而以分支为基础的执行只能返回紧凑的子任务结果(Sun等,2025). 相反,外部历史方法在保持对活性上下文的限定的同时,保留了在快取之外对早期相互作用的获取(Packer等,2024;Li等,2026),而一些系统则验证压缩表达与后续执行相抗衡以减少信息损失(Chen等,2026b.).

blocks.en:
Complementary approaches represent task progress explicitly, reducing reliance on raw interaction history alone. Some maintain an internal state by integrating prior memory with new observations ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , while others use structured representations, such as execution-state trees, persistent variables, or task records ( Chen et al., 2026a ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . Recent systems further externalize state into persistent workspaces and reconstruct the model’s working context through snapshots or programmatic selection ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
Across these approaches, continuation is primarily organized around compressed interaction history or externally maintained state. Our approach instead makes reusable task objects the primary unit of continuation.
blocks.zh:
补充办法明确代表任务进展,仅依靠原始互动历史就减少。 有的通过将先前的内存与新的观测结果(周等,2025;刘等,2025)相融合来保持内部状态;有的则使用结构化的表示方式,如执行状态树,持久性变量,或任务记录(陈等,2026a; 天等,2026;吴等,2026a;马等,2026. 最近的系统进一步将状态外部化为持续的工作空间,并通过快照或程序选择重建模型的工作环境(Yu等,2026;Lin等,2026;Zhu等,2026)。
通过这些方法,继续主要围绕压缩互动历史或外部维持状态来组织。 相反,我们的做法使可重复使用的任务成为延续的主要单位。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates CarryOn, which organizes long-horizon continuation around reusable task objects rather than the interactions that produced them. Reusable objects carry established progress for subsequent inspection and use, while explicit context retains complementary continuation information. Alongside the agent’s interaction loop, a Tracker identifies candidate reusable progress, which is bound to supporting evidence and, when applicable, checked by a Grounder . A Compiler jointly updates continuation carriers and execution context. After validation, the update replaces the covered interaction history through a fold , while subsequent interactions form a new live tail.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了TurryOn,它围绕可重复使用的任务对象安排长相续作,而不是产生这些对象的相互作用。 可再利用的物体带有既定进展,供随后检查和使用,而明确上下文保留了补充性继续信息。 除了代理的交互循环之外,跟踪器还识别了可重复使用的候选进度,该进度必须附有证据,并在适用时由地表人检查。 A编译器联合更新续作载体和执行上下文. 经验证后,更新通过折叠来取代被覆盖的交互历史,而后续的交互则会形成新的活尾.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the CarryOn framework. CarryOn maintains an object-oriented context view comprising continuation carriers, execution context, and a live tail. When invoked, it tracks reusable progress, binds supporting evidence, checks relevant environment conditions, and jointly compiles carrier and execution-context updates. A successful fold commits validated updates and retires covered live-tail interactions from active context, while interaction log remains append-only.
blocks.zh: 图2:载运概况 在框架上。 携带 保持面向对象的上下文视图,包括续航母、执行上下文和活尾。 在援引时,它跟踪可重复使用的进展,绑定辅助证据,检查相关的环境条件,并联合汇编载体和执行文本的更新. 一个成功的折叠将输入经验证的更新,并退出覆盖在活动上下文中的活尾互动,而互动日志则仅保留附件。

blocks.en: 3.2 Context View
blocks.zh: 3.2 上下文视图

blocks.en: We organize the agent’s active context into three complementary components: continuation carriers , which expose reusable task objects; execution context , which preserves continuation information not captured by those carriers; and a live tail , which retains interactions accumulated since the latest fold.
blocks.zh: 我们把代理人的活性背景分为三个互补部分:延续载体,它暴露了可重复使用的任务对象;执行上下文,它保存了这些载体没有获取的活性信息;活性尾巴,它保留了自最近折叠以来积累的相互作用。

blocks.en: Continuation carriers expose reusable progress to subsequent execution. Each carrier has a stable identity and records the reusable content or its location, together with conditions for reuse. Revisions create successor versions under the same identity, while unaffected carriers retain their records. Depending on where the reusable progress resides, CarryOn supports three forms of carriers:
blocks.zh: 继续运营的承运人将可重复使用的进展置于随后的执行。 每个载体具有稳定的身份,记录可再使用的内容或其位置,以及再利用的条件。 修订以相同身份创建后继版本,而未受影响的承运人保留其记录. 视可重复使用进度的所在地而定,AllOn支持三种运输方式:

blocks.en: • External Objects : External objects are work products that exist independently in the environment and can be reopened or modified, such as code files, documents, and spreadsheets. Their carrier records reference the underlying objects and describe the progress they capture together with conditions for reuse. • Information Products : Information products capture reusable findings obtained through interaction, such as synthesized information or troubleshooting conclusions. When not materialized as persistent objects, the carriers store the findings directly, with supporting sources and reuse conditions. • Situated State : Situated state captures progress available only within a particular application, session, or workflow. Reusing such progress requires returning to the environment in which the state resides. Its carrier therefore records the environment anchor, the established state, and the scope within which that state remains reusable.
blocks.zh: • 外部对象:外部对象是指在环境中独立存在,可以重新打开或修改的工作产品,如代码文件,文档,电子表格等. 它们的载体记录提及了所根据的物体,并描述了它们捕捉的进展以及再利用的条件。 • 信息产品:信息产品捕捉通过互动获得的可重复使用的结论,如综合信息或解决问题的结论。 如果未作为持久性物体实现,则载体直接储存这些发现,并附有佐证来源和再利用条件。 二. 支助 位置状态 : 位置状态只捕捉特定应用程序、会话或工作流程中可用的进度。 重新利用这些进展需要回到国家所居住的环境。 因此,其航空母舰记录了环境锚地、既定状态以及该状态可再使用的范围。

blocks.en: External Objects : External objects are work products that exist independently in the environment and can be reopened or modified, such as code files, documents, and spreadsheets. Their carrier records reference the underlying objects and describe the progress they capture together with conditions for reuse.
blocks.zh: 外出对象:外出对象是指在环境中独立存在,可以重开或修改的工作产品,如代码文件,文档,以及电子表格等. 它们的载体记录提及了所根据的物体,并描述了它们捕捉的进展以及再利用的条件。

blocks.en: Information Products : Information products capture reusable findings obtained through interaction, such as synthesized information or troubleshooting conclusions. When not materialized as persistent objects, the carriers store the findings directly, with supporting sources and reuse conditions.
blocks.zh: 信息产品:信息产品捕捉到通过互动获得的可重复使用的结论,如综合信息或排除出故障的结论. 如果未作为持久性物体实现,则载体直接储存这些发现,并附有佐证来源和再利用条件。

blocks.en: Situated State : Situated state captures progress available only within a particular application, session, or workflow. Reusing such progress requires returning to the environment in which the state resides. Its carrier therefore records the environment anchor, the established state, and the scope within which that state remains reusable.
blocks.zh: 位置状态 : 位置状态只捕捉特定应用程序、会话或工作流程中可用的进度。 重新利用这些进展需要回到国家所居住的环境。 因此,其航空母舰记录了环境锚地、既定状态以及该状态可再使用的范围。

blocks.en: These carrier types are complementary rather than mutually exclusive. A task may therefore involve multiple carriers, and the same carrier may be revised as its underlying progress evolves.
blocks.zh: 这些载体类型是相辅相成的,而不是相互排斥的。 因此,一项任务可能涉及多个承运人,而同一承运人可能随着其基本进展的发展而修订。

blocks.en:
Execution context complements continuation carriers by retaining information
needed for execution but not encoded in reusable task objects.
It records the current focus, unresolved constraints and obligations,
and pending work not materialized into a reusable carrier.
blocks.zh:
执行上下文通过保留信息来补充继续承运人
执行时需要,但不在可重复使用的任务对象中编码。
它记录了当前的重点、尚未解决的制约因素和义务,
并且尚未完成的工程没有变成可重复使用的承运人。

blocks.en: Live Tail . Live tail contains the original agent–environment interactions accumulated since the most recent fold. These interactions remain directly available until incorporated into a subsequent fold.
blocks.zh: 活着的尾巴。 活尾包含自最近折叠以来所积累的原始剂-环境相互作用. 这些相互作用在并入以后的折叠之前仍然可以直接使用。

blocks.en: 3.3 Constructing and Updating the Context View
blocks.zh: 3.3 构建和更新上下文视图

blocks.en: To maintain this context view during execution, CarryOn periodically folds accumulated interactions in the live tail into the maintained representation. Each fold identifies reusable progress, associates it with supporting evidence, and preserves the information still needed for continuation. The update proceeds in four stages: tracking candidates, preparing evidence, joint compilation, and validation and commitment.
blocks.zh: 为了在执行期间保持这种上下文视图,BearOn定期将活尾部所积累的相互作用折叠入所保持的表示. 每一叠都指明可重复使用的进展,将其与佐证联系起来,并保存继续所需的信息。 更新工作分四个阶段进行:跟踪候选人、准备证据、联合汇编、验证和承诺。

blocks.en:
CarryOn first identifies progress that may become reusable in subsequent execution. The Tracker maintains candidates, each representing a potential new carrier or an update to an existing one.
As execution proceeds, candidates may remain under development across multiple Tracker invocations; once a candidate has reached a state that can support continuation, the Tracker requests its compilation.
blocks.zh:
TurryOn首先确定在后续执行中可能重复使用的进展. 跟踪员保留候选人,每个代表潜在的新载体或对现有载体的更新。
随着执行的进行,候选人可能仍然在跨越多个Tracker引用的开发中;一旦一名候选人达到能够支持续作的状态,Tracker就要求其编译.

blocks.en:
A compilation request specifies both what should be compiled and the evidence needed to support it.
For external objects and situated state, this includes the relevant environment object together with the state or conditions required for its reuse.
For information products, it includes the source material from which reusable information should be retained. Candidates that are not yet ready remain tracked for later folds.
blocks.zh:
汇编请求既规定了应当汇编的内容,也规定了支持汇编所需的证据。
对于外部物体和位置状态,这包括相关环境物体及其再利用所需的状态或条件。
对于信息产品,它包括应保留可重复使用的信息的来源材料。 尚未准备好的候选人将留作以后的折叠。

blocks.en:
Before compilation, CarryOn first gathers the evidence authorized for each selected candidate.
When compilation updates an existing carrier, it also includes the carrier’s current record.
For information products, CarryOn checks that the selected material is consistent with its recorded sources.
For external objects and situated state, it binds the request to the corresponding environment object, and the Grounder performs read-only checks of relevant conditions where available.
The resulting input package U t U_{t} contains the selected candidates, applicable carrier records, authorized source material, object references, and available check results.
This package fixes the record versions and evidence against which proposed carrier edits are later validated. Additional details are given in Appendix A.2 .

blocks.en: The Compiler proposes edits only for the selected candidates, grounding each edit in its authorized evidence. In contrast, the execution context is revised against the entire live tail to preserve continuation-relevant information. For external objects and situated state, the Compiler records reusable progress and its condition of use, while the underlying objects or states remain in the environment. For information products, it stores reusable findings directly in carrier records. In parallel, the Compiler revises execution context using the live tail, retaining active requirements and unfinished work not captured by carriers, including information outside the selected candidates. Upon successful validation, affected carriers receive successor versions, while unaffected carriers retain their existing records.
blocks.zh: 编译器只提议为所选候选人进行编辑,每次编辑都在其授权的证据中打下基础. 相比之下,执行背景与整个直播尾巴相对照而修订,以保存与续作有关的信息. 对于外部对象和位置状态,编译器记录可重复使用的进展及其使用状况,而基础对象或状态则留在环境中. 对于信息产品,它直接将可重复使用的调查结果储存在承运人的记录中。 同时,编译器使用活尾来修改执行上下文,保留主动要求和载体没有捕获的未完成的工作,包括被选中候选人以外的信息. 成功验证后,受影响的承运人收到后续版本,而未受影响的承运人保留其现有记录。

blocks.en:
Before a proposed update changes the active context, CarryOn checks that its carrier edits still refer to the current candidate and carrier versions and are consistent with the evidence authorized for their compilation requests. It also verifies the required identity, reference, and output constraints. A successful fold must introduce at least one carrier change; revising the execution context alone does not retire interaction history.
These checks guard the runtime against inconsistent or unsupported updates; they do not verify task correctness.
blocks.zh:
在拟议更新改变活性上下文之前,AllOn检查其载体编辑时仍然参考当前候选版本和载体版本,并符合为其汇编请求授权的证据。 它还核查所需的身份、参考和产出限制。 一个成功的折叠必须至少引入一个载体变化;仅修订执行上下文并不能使互动历史退休.
这些检查会保护运行时间不被不一致或不支持的更新;它们不会验证任务正确性.

blocks.en: If these checks fail, the existing context view and live tail remain unchanged. Otherwise, CarryOn atomically applies the carrier edits and commits the revised execution context, advancing the fold through the covered interactions. In the current implementation, a successful fold covers the entire live tail. The resulting carrier set and execution context define the folded portion of the next context view, while subsequent interactions begin a new live tail.
blocks.zh: 如果这些检查失败,则现有上下文视图和活尾保持不变. 否则,CryOn在原子上应用了载体编辑并承担了修改后的执行上下文,通过覆盖的相互作用来推进折叠. 在目前的实施中,一个成功的折叠覆盖了整个直播尾巴. 由此产生的载体集和执行上下文定义了下个上下文视图的折叠部分,而后的互动开始一个新的活尾.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate CarryOn on OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) to assess its performance across different types of long-horizon tasks.
We use the full OSWorld 2.0 benchmark as our primary evaluation for its long execution horizons, complex workflows, and task diversity.
We additionally evaluate our method on a randomly sampled subset of 100 BrowseComp-Plus questions, which require iterative search across multiple sources and provide a complementary setting for studying context management over long search histories. Benchmark details are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们通过OSWorld 2.0(袁克等,2026年)和浏览Comp-Plus(陈克等,2025年)来评价其在不同类型长视距任务上的性能.
我们使用完整的OSWorld 2.0基准作为我们对其长期执行范围,复杂工作流程,任务多样性的主要评价.
我们还根据100个浏览器Comp-Plus问题的随机抽样子集来评估我们的方法,这需要跨多个来源的迭代搜索,并为研究长期搜索历史的上下文管理提供一个补充环境。 基准细节见附录B.1。

blocks.en: We use Claude Opus 4.7 for the host agent, CarryOn’s Tracker, and Compiler. We use a 500-step budget per task on OSWorld 2.0, and the agent retrieves documents using BM25 ( Robertson et al., 1995 ) on BrowseComp-Plus. Detailed experimental configurations and implementation settings are provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用Claude Opus 4.7作为主持人代理, 我们使用OSWorld 2.0上的500步预算,代理在浏览Comp-Plus上检索使用BM25(Robertson等人,1995年)的文件。 附录A.3提供了详细的实验配置和执行设置。

blocks.en: On OSWorld 2.0, we report partial score and binary score, following the official evaluation protocol. On BrowseComp-Plus, we report answer accuracy, with final responses assessed by Qwen3-32B using the benchmark’s official grading prompt. We measure efficiency through token usage per task and cost per task, including both agent and context-management calls.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison with Context Management Strategies
blocks.zh: 4.4 与背景管理战略的比较

blocks.en:
We examine the proposed object-oriented organization against conventional history compression, and compare the full CarryOn runtime with a summary-based implementation of the same principles.
On the same random 40-task subset of OSWorld 2.0, we compare:
(i) Baseline , the default OSWorld 2.0 agent setting without additional context compression;
(ii) Sliding Window , which retains only recent messages;
(iii) Generic Summary (GS) , which summarizes earlier history into a continuation note; and
(iv) CarryOn-Guided Summary (CGS) , which applies our object-oriented organizing principles within a textual summary.
Sliding Window and GS follow the FIFO truncation and prompting-based summarization baselines of Kang et al. (2026) .
All methods use the same host model (Claude Opus 4.7), the same trigger condition, and the same step budget.
blocks.zh:
我们对照传统的历史压缩来审查拟议的以对象为导向的组织,并将整个运行时间与对同样原则的简易执行进行比较。
在OSWorld 2.0相同的随机40任务子集上,我们比较:
(一) 基线,默认的OSWorld 2.0代理设置,不附加上下文压缩;
(二) 滑动窗口,只保留最近的信息;
(三) 一般性摘要(GS),将以前的历史归纳为续作;和
(四) 载有指导性摘要(CGS),在文字摘要中适用我们面向对象的组织原则。
滑动窗口和GS遵循了FIFO的截取并基于Kang等人的汇总基线(2026年)。
所有方法都采用相同的主机模式(Claude Opus 4.7),相同的触发条件,以及相同的步预算.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 4 , aggressive history compression does not improve performance by itself: Sliding Window and GS retain the shortest contexts but reduce both binary and partial scores relative to the baseline.
Applying the same organizing principles through CGS recovers much of this loss, reaching a 50.93% partial score.
Full CarryOn further increases the partial score to 55.93% while matching the baseline binary score of 22.50%.
Compared with CGS, CarryOn achieves 5.00% higher partial score with about 10% shorter post-fold text.
Together, these results show that our object-oriented organization principle is effective even when applied within a textual summary, while the full CarryOn runtime yields further improvements, demonstrating the additional benefit of maintaining and managing this structured state explicitly during execution.
blocks.zh:
如表4所示,积极的历史压缩本身并不能提高性能: 滑动窗口和GS保留了最短的上下文,但相对于基线降低了二进制和部分分数.
通过CGS应用同样的组织原理可以挽回大部分损失,达到50.93%的部分分数.
满载 进一步将部分分数提高到55.93%,同时与基线二进制分数22.50%相匹配.
与CGS相比,携带 在完成5.00%的较高部分分数时,大约缩短了10%的后倍文本.
这些结果表明,我们面向对象的组织原则即使在文字摘要中适用也是有效的,而整个运行时间则产生进一步的改进,表明在执行期间明确保持和管理这种结构化状态的额外好处。

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 分析

blocks.en:
We conduct an ablation study on the shared 40-task OSWorld 2.0 subset by hiding either continuation carriers or execution context from the host agent.
As shown in Table 5 , removing execution context reduces binary score from 22.50% to 17.50% and partial score from 55.93% to 44.00%, while the number of agent calls changes little.
The carriers still expose completed progress, but the agent loses complementary goals, constraints, and unresolved requirements needed to finish the task. Removing continuation carriers reduces partial score to 44.62%, while increasing agent calls by 23.8% and cost by 22.3%. Without direct access to established progress, the agent must recover or reproduce earlier results before continuing.
This behavior is visible in trajectory-level examples in
Appendix C.2 . Together, the two ablations show that carriers and execution context preserve distinct, complementary information for continuation.
blocks.zh:
我们对共享的40个任务OSWorld 2.0子集进行消融研究,将续作载体或执行上下文隐藏在主机代理中.
如表5所示,去除执行上下文将二进制得分从22.50%降至17.50%,部分得分从55.93%降至44.00%,而代理通话次数变化不大.
承运人仍然揭露已完成的进展,但代理人丧失了完成任务所需的互补目标、制约因素和尚未满足的要求。 清除续航母将部分分数降至44.62%,同时将代理通话增加23.8%并增加22.3%。 在无法直接获取既定进展的情况下,制剂必须恢复或复制更早的成果后才能继续。
这种行为在轨迹级别的例子中可见于
附录C.2 这两起事件合在一起表明,承运人和执行背景保存了独特的补充信息,供继续使用。

blocks.en: To examine how carrier records evolve as execution progresses, we compare them before and after each committed fold in CarryOn’s OSWorld 2.0 trajectories. Figure 4 (a) shows that 80% of carrier records are retained or updated. This pattern reflects an evolving representation of task progress in which existing records remain available across folds, while updates incorporate subsequent work on the same task objects. CGS follows the same organizing principles but maintains this information by generating a complete replacement summary at each fold. Despite retaining more post-fold text, CGS achieves a lower partial score than CarryOn (50.93% vs. 55.93%) as shown in Table 4 . Explicitly maintaining records as task objects evolve may help the agent build on prior progress, providing one possible explanation for CarryOn’s higher score.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce CarryOn, a context runtime that organizes long-horizon agent context around reusable task objects. Our method combines continuation carriers that expose reusable progress, execution context that preserves complementary goals, constraints, and unresolved issues, and a live tail of recent interactions. As the task progresses, CarryOn jointly updates continuation carriers and execution context to reflect evolving task state and remaining requirements, progressively replacing covered interaction history with an updated context view. On OSWorld 2.0, CarryOn raises partial score from 43.9% to 49.7% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and nominal model cost by 35.9%, including runtime overhead. On BrowseComp-Plus, it increases accuracy from 49% to 56% with lower token usage and cost. Together, these results support object-oriented context management for long-horizon agents, where task objects carry established progress and explicit context evolves with what is still needed to move forward.
